ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Sep-05-2006 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: Cynthia Herbert, CSR: Janet Pond.
Atty. Jennifer Kassan, Esquire appeared for the Petitioner Francisco Nicola Montgomery, was sworn and examined.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name to: NICOLAS RYAN MONTGOMERY.
Decree signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Aug-15-2006 Reset To Sep-05-06 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 218 For Order To Show Cause
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Vicky Gross.
No appearance by the Attorney of Record: Jennifer Kassan.
Petitioner: Francisco Nicola Montgomery, present, was sworn and examined.
Unable to provide to the Court a Proof of Publication, matter is continued to Sept. 5, 2006 at 9:00 A.M. in Dept. 218, for Petitioner to file the Proof of Publication and for an appearance by counsel.
